pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions exhibiting sharp geometric vertices on the lower neck, transitioning to smaller, more rounded shapes on the posterior flank. Edges show moderate pixel-gradient softness consistent with depth-of-field effects.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous off-white topological mesh. Junction nodes primarily feature tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Network pathways show relatively uniform pixel thickness, with a slight increase in width separating smaller posterior patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette representing the mane along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, contrasting as a dark textured line against the background.
